description: Chat modes admitted to the durable harness. durableChatModes: an agent's (Node DURABLE_CHAT_MODES); Python derives the same set from MODE_CATALOG: 'auto' plus every mode and alias whose loop kind the durable kernel runs ('react', and 'orchestrator' since K-L). assistantChatModes: the built-in assistant's (Node DURABLE_ASSISTANT_CHAT_MODES); Python derives them from the canonical ChatModePolicy names that legacy serves from /chat/stream (Node sends any mode naming 'agent' to the agent route).
